title: Accounts Administrator

If you are an experienced Accounts Administrator with Sage experience and are available to start immediately, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for immediate consideration.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Want a finance role where you can own the day-to-day accounts without spending every hour buried in them? This Finance & Operations Administrator position gives you a finance focused role, alongside enough operational variety to keep things interesting, plus the opportunity to become involved in management accounts once you're settled in.

Reporting to the Managing Director, you will be responsible for:
- Managing purchase and sales ledger activity
- Preparing payment runs, processing BACS payments and issuing remittances
- Supporting VAT returns, WIP and P&L analysis
- Getting involved with management accounts reporting as you develop in the role
- Assisting with, supplier queries, quotations and order confirmations
- Providing administration support during projects
- Spotting opportunities to streamline processes and make everyday tasks more efficient

What you will need:
- Previous experience in a similar finance role, such as Finance Administrator, Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Accounts Administrator
- Confidence using Excel, including formulas, with the ability to work with and learn functions such as VLOOKUPs and PivotTables
- Good general IT skills, with Sage 50 and SharePoint experience advantageous
- A collaborative approach and an interest in building a long-term role within a small team

What you will get:
- 27 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Up to 12 wellbeing days each year
- Your birthday off
- Company pension
- Free on-site parking
- Early finishes on Friday
- The opportunity to broaden your finance experience into management accounts over time

If you would like to find out more about this role, please apply with your CV or LinkedIn PDF. We look forward to hearing from you!

We take your application seriously and WE RESPOND TO EVERY APPLICATION because getting a job is hard enough.

The Niche Partnership is acting as a recruitment business in relation to this role. The Niche Partnership complies with all relevant UK legislation and doesn't discriminate on any protected characteristics. title: Finance Assistant - Temporary
description:
As a Finance Assistant in Farnborough, you will help keep accounting records organised and up to date for an automotive organisation. You will handle day-to-day finance tasks that help the finance department run smoothly during this temporary assignment.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the automotive industry in Farnborough.

Description
- Maintain accurate finance records to support clear and timely reporting.
- Process financial information carefully and keep documents well organised.
- Update accounting systems with accurate data and resolve basic record queries.
- Prepare routine finance paperwork for review by the Accounting & Finance department.
- Check transactions and supporting documents for completeness and accuracy.
- Help keep finance files current, accessible and easy to track.
- Work with colleagues to ensure day-to-day finance tasks are completed on time.

Profile

A successful 'Finance Assistant' should have:
- Experience completing day-to-day finance administration tasks.
- Confidence working with financial records and accurate data entry.
- Ability to organise documents and maintain clear finance files.
- A careful approach when checking transactions and supporting information.
- Ability to manage routine tasks and meet agreed deadlines.
- Comfort working as part of an Accounting & Finance department.

Job Offer

A salary of up to £30,000.

Please note this is a temporary position.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper
description:
A growing organisation are looking to recruit a Part-Time Bookkeeper on a permanent basis who will be responsible for managing transactional aspects of finance and supporting the business in decision making. The business pride themselves on the fact that they have low staff turnover so this is a rare opportunity to join them.

Key responsibilities:
- Processing payments
- Chasing unpaid invoices and resolving customer queries in a timely and effective manner
- Creating and posting journals
- Invoice creation and submittal for payment
- Preparation of month-end accounts to trial balance
- Bank reconciliations
- Payroll
- Ad hoc projects and tasks when required

The ideal candidate will have/be:
- A proven track record of working in a similar role
- Excellent IT skills including Excel and Xero
- Professional with excellent communication skills as building and maintaining internal and external relationships is key as you will be working with non finance colleagues
- Organised and adaptable with the ability to work well under pressure and to strict deadlines with excellent attention to detail

Key information:
- Free on-site parking
- 24 hours per work
- 25 days holiday pro rata
- Hours are very flexible and will be agreed to ensure they work for both parties but they must be worked in the office with the team. Hybrid working is NOT an option
- Accessible by public transport
- INTERVIEWING ASAP

title: Purchase Ledger Administrator
description:
Amour Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting for a Purchase Ledger Administrator on behalf of our long-standing client based in Southampton.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable professional looking for a varied role within a busy finance team.

Reporting to the Accounts Manager, you'll take ownership of key purchase ledger responsibilities while also supporting the wider account's function.

What you'll be doing
- Managing the day-to-day purchase ledger
- Processing purchase invoices accurately and efficiently
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies
- Preparing and processing monthly supplier payment runs
- Posting purchase payments and issuing remittance advices to suppliers
- Posting daily bank transactions, including receipts and payments
- Assisting with bank reconciliations
- Supporting with credit control and general accounts administration

What we're looking for
- Previous experience within Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable or a similar accounts administration role is essential
- Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and accounting systems
- Good numerical and organisational skills
- Ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines

Salary: company happy to negotiate for experience

Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm

If you're an experienced Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable professional who enjoys a varied role and would like to join a well-established business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
Why work for us?

We're more than just tools and we offer more than just a job. We've been family run since day one so working at Draper Tools is about being a part of the extended Draper family - a family that is rich in history, heritage and continued success.

We know our people make our company what it is and our teams are passionate about new ideas, new ways of working and continuous improvement, so we work hard to make sure each person has the tools they need to thrive and succeed.

People enjoy working for us; we welcome, invest in and value our employees and one in six have worked for Draper for more than 25 years!

We're looking for a Sales Ledger Clerk, to join our busy Credit Control department, who will be responsible for ensuring our customer accounts are accurately maintained and invoices are processed efficiently. If this sounds like the right role for you, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Working as our Sales Ledger Clerk your role will include:
- Monthly reconciliation of accounts.
- Chasing overdue debts by telephone, email or written communications up to court summons stage.
- All aspects of query resolution in order to resolve customer invoice disputes and enable payment to be made.
- Directly liaising with internal and external Sales and Warehouse staff regarding accounts.
- Producing credit note request documentation and updating the internal systems
- Daily allocation of cash receipts

Requirements
- Strong administrative skills - previous sales ledger experience isn't essential
- Excellent communications skills, both written and verbal
- Excellent Telephone manner
- Calm and professional approach to dealing with customers
- Highly organised with exceptionally high standards and attention to detail
- Proactive approach to tasks and confident with problem solving
- Excellent IT skills

Benefits

As our Sales Ledger Clerk your benefits will include:
- 25 days holiday with the ability to purchase additional leave
- Day off for your birthday
- Pension scheme
- Medical cash plan providing cash back on everyday medical costs
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
- Private health scheme
- Staff discount on Draper products with significant savings available
- Employee discount scheme - discounts on gym memberships, groceries, holidays and more
- Long service bonus and awards
- Death in Service Insurance
- Ad-hoc rewards and recognition
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Free onsite parking

Please note this role will be based full time at our Head Office in Chandlers Ford.
